selection: Use only the exactly selected market, policy family and model class pairs recorded in the immutable V3 development tournament; markets without a selection remain without a model artifact.
refit: Fit each selected fixed-hyperparameter model on every common-evaluable opportunity in its frozen V3 development market cohort, including the prior development assessment rows. Use only NORMAL_P75 net returns to define argmax(NO_TRADE,LONG,SHORT) targets; ties choose NO_TRADE then LONG. No validation or holdout feature or outcome may be read.
feature_order: Use the exact ordered feature_names from the immutable V3 tournament report.
serialisation: One joblib binary per selected market, model, and policy with SHA-256 and training-membership/prediction hashes in a no-overwrite manifest; loading must verify the binary hash first.
